usedFor: MailerLite reports subscriber events like “Campaign Sent”, and viaSocket utilities waits with “Pause Workflow” before the run continues.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscriber Created” in MailerLite, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber waits X minutes before the next step, which puts a delay after signup.

watchOut: “Pause Workflow” only holds the run for X minutes, so a step after it must do the actual work.
